listing.aiSummary: Adjusts vanilla ship systems, weapons, fighters, and hull stats to improve underperforming options.

description:
A Vanilla Balance Tweak1.4.0

Changes many Vanilla shipsystems, weapons, fighters, and ships with the intent of improving underperforming options and increasing variety

Ship variants have been adjusted to account for the adjusted weapons and ship stats

Expect conflicts with mods that also change vanilla content

Known to be incompatible with Emergent Threats

Should be safe to add/remove from existing saves, though ships should be stripped of equipment before removal

Download

https://github.com/RiftandRend/A-Vanilla-Balance-Tweak/releases/latest/download/A-Vanilla-Balance-Tweak.zip

Screenshots

Spoiler

Somewhat tested, so nothing should be egregiously overpowered. Feedback is appreciated.

Notable changes made below, list is not exhaustive

Ballistics

Spoiler

The 3 MGs are in an odd place in vanilla, while technically PD most of their use is as melee range
kinetics on SO ships. As PD, they're not very effective, due to poor range and awkward burst timings.
Increasing range and projectile speed, while decreasing DPS and Efficiency allows them to
fulfil a dual purpose PD/secondary shield pressure role on more ships.

The Vulcan is pretty good PD on larger ships with range boosts, but inconsistent when mounted on frigates and fighters.
Increasing range while reducing DPS and accuracy brings it's performance floor and ceiling closer together.
A minor EMP component allows Vulcan armed fighters to harass otherwise immune armored targets.

The Thumper has been transformed into a super-Vulcan, gaining the ability to shoot at missiles
along with an efficiency buff and burst size reduction. Fills a true generalist role, being
somewhat effective against everything but armor.

More shots per burst, slight DPS increase. Longer delay between bursts presents gaps for a sustained missile barrage,
but much better at destroying massed or durable targets like torpedoes.

The Light Mortar is one of the few truly terrible weapons in vanilla, with poor range, damage, dps, and hitrate.
Damage per shot and flux efficiency have been significantly increased, so the few shots that hit will be decently effective.
Makes heavily armored low tech ships like Enforcer and Venture less insurmountable to ships without missiles.

While not as useless as it's light counterpart, the Heavy Mortar is decidedly mediocre, and used
only when no alternative can be found. A minor increase to damage and efficiency make it less
disappointing without encroaching on the more expensive options.

Given the "USE_LESS_VS_SHIELDS" weapon tag to prevent it's limited DPS being wasted.
Effectively punishes shield flickering.

Cost and DPS have both been reduced, giving ships with many mounts or limited OP
an effective tool. DPS per mount and accuracy are poor, compared to alternatives.

Flux efficiency returned to its .96 levels. Horrific accuracy reduces real flux/damage ratios
at extended range, limiting it's effectiveness in BRF builds without recoil reduction.

The Arbalest is outclassed in most respects by small ballistics, which offer similar DPS and efficiency for less cost.
The efficiency has been increased, along with minor nerfs to small ballistics give it more of a role.

The Heavy Autocannon's accuracy is surprisingly poor, many shots missing cruiser sized targets without
significant recoil/accuracy improvements. This makes it's effectiveness in the early game and on ships
that can't afford these enhancements (i.e. Carriers, Missile Ships) significantly worse. Increasing accuracy
and efficiency with a counterbalancing DPS reduction makes it much more reliable on support ships.

The Mark IX has gone essentially unchanged since it's addition to the game over 10 years ago.
DPS, efficiency, and accuracy slightly increased, competes with medium and small alternatives.

The Light Assault Gun has a tiny niche, as an HE tool for frigate duels. Outside of this, the low damage per shot makes it's practical DPS very low when shooting at larger ships. Improved damage and efficiency make it a tiny Hephaestus.

Almost exclusively used by SO builds, the Assault Chaingun is useless on most ships.
Exchanging 20% of its DPS for a massive range boost makes it a more deadly
alternative to the Mauler and Mortar, while reducing the effectiveness of SO builds.

DPS slightly decreased, alongside changed to other small kinetics.
Refire delay now split between rapid charg-up and moderate cooldown, improving performance
when autofiring. Minor EMP addition occasionally disables weapons if used en masse.

The HVEL driver can be oppressive when mounted on fast ships. Now fires a 2-shot burst
with slightly reduced DPS and Hitstrength but increased EMP.

The Gauss cannon is a very niche weapon, used on kiting Conquests and little else due to extreme flux costs.
To improve it's viability across more ships, it's been redesigned along similar lines to the HVEL driver, with
reduced DPS and hitstrength in exchange for improved burst damage. Its also been made much more
reliable, with an interruptible charge-up and much faster turning speed, which somewhat makes up for the loss in DPS.

Like the Gauss, Mjolnir use is mostly limited to the Conquest. Flux efficiency is increased
slightly, along with significant increases to the EMP damage and projectile speed (900->1100).

The Light Needler is slightly too strong, and is now exactly half a Heavy Needler in terms of dps.
Nerfed refire delay now exactly matches both the Heavy Mauler and Phase Lance, which
makes Phase anchor builds combining these weapons slightly better under AI control.

Energy Weapons

Spoiler

The Anti-matter Blaster overperforms on ships that can ignore the 1500 soft flux load, and is a
major contributor to the success of the Afflictor. Reducing it's OP cost and damage while increasing
efficiency and range makes it an option on more ships while weakening its main abusers.

Now gains charges in sets of 15, rather than continuously. Noticeably better on ships with
HEF, minimal difference elsewhere.

A mediocre weapon, the IRPL limits ships that rely on small energies for shield pressure.
Range, efficiency, and OP cost have been improved.
Projectile velocity doubled, making it very accurate against fast moving targets.

Less mediocre than the IRPL, but still a bit lacking.
Range increased, now a genuinely medium-range weapon.
Viable choice on aggressive midline builds, great with EBC.

The Heavy Blaster is mostly restricted to SO ships due to the massive flux generation.
An efficiency improvement and a minor EMP component mitigate this somewhat.

The Kinetic Blaster often finds its place filled by the Pulse Laser or Heavy Blaster.
To set it apart, it now fires a more efficient 4-shot burst. On ships with HEF this can threaten smaller
ships with immediate overloads

The Ion Cannon's relatively low EMP output and low range make it the most
affected by enemy EMP reduction. A buff to the EMP damage and flux efficiency
balances the risk vs reward.

Ranged and DPS increased, damage type switched to HE to match the Mining Blaster.
Allows ships relying on Frag or Kinetic PD to handle armored fighters.

The PD Laser has been adjusted to be a dual purpose weapon, offering
average PD effectiveness alongside light-armor melting.

The Vanilla LRPD Laser's low DPS makes in unsuited for stopping much more than stray salamanders.
An increase in range and the ability to fire over allied ships makes massed LRPDs much more effective.
A smidge of EMP makes many converging beams able to disable fighters somewhat reliably.

The Burst PD Lasers have been slightly adjusted, firing shorter more intense bursts.
This slightly improves effectiveness against armor and reduces overkill when engaging multiple targets.

The Paladin has been given a general statistical buff, but regains charges in blocks of 10 rather
than continuously. This presents windows of vulnerability if a ship has no other PD.

An OP decrease, efficiency increase, and minor EMP addition make the
Tactical Laser easier to mass and somewhat more effective.

The Phase Lance now fires without the chargup-chargedown period, dealing the entire
burst's damage at the full hitstrength. Slight stat reduction to compensate.

Missiles

Spoiler

Both launchers gain more ammo, rockets are faster and slightly more durability.
Pod now releases rockets at max speed, much better at leading moving targets.

Years ago, in .8a the Atropos had it's speed nerfed from 500-400 but didn't gain any lifetime to compensate.
This, combined with it's lazy guidance leads to frequent burnouts and misses just before impact if fired near max range.
Range and speed increased, now closer in performance to unguided torpedoes.

AI hints adjusted to make ships more willing to fire in less perfect situations.
Practical effectiveness increased somewhat.

Implemented an unused vanilla weapon, essentially an HE bomblet shotgun.
Only effective at point blank or against stationary targets.

Increased HP, all launchers now release the torpedo at maximum speed.
Larger launchers have slightly more ammo.

Faster fire and reloading rate. Secondary stage has increased HP and
speed, still just as clumsy. Very effective at baiting missile PD.

Ammo increased, cooldown of small slight increased.

More ammo, higher missile HP and lifetime.

Reworked, the Swarmer is now regenerates ammo and prefers missiles
and fighters to ships. Missiles have a proximity warhead. Changes apply to the fighter version.

Reworked into a PD/Assault weapon, the PCL now provides
exceptional PD, limited by very long ammo reloads.

Reworked into a regenerating PD/Suppression weapon, the Locust fires single missiles and provides area PD
similarly to a Paladin. Lacks the splash damage of the other missile slot PD options.

Reworked into a regenerating MRM to give it a role not already filled by the Sabot. Essentially a 2500 range
Graviton Beam with 75% of the DPS, dropping to 50% once reserves empty.
Missiles are quite tough, and draw PD attention away from more valuable missiles.

Increased ammo alongside changes to other missiles.

Much more ammo for both medium and large Dragonfires. More lifetime, durability, greater
standoff range, and improved AI hints make it much more reliable.

Reworked; now regenerates ammo and builds flux to fire. Base damage decreased but
bonus damage increased. Now flies very fast and deals significant EMP damage.

Increased ammo and adjusted AI hints. Should fire at vulnerable targets more often.

Fighters

Spoiler
All fighters have had their speed and maneuverability stats adjusted. A blanket deceleration nerf keeps fighters
from slowing down, and makes them more difficult targets for PD. Bombers have their attack range
increased, and are agile enough to turn away before entering most PD range.

LMG weapon arcs increased significantly, spends much more time shooting and less time turning to shoot.

Durability and speed slightly improved. Ion Cannon (High Delay) now fires a burst of 2 shots, DPS unchanged.
The burst firing focuses EMP on fewer parts of the target, and more reliably disables components.

Now has ECCM and launches its Reaper from much longer range. Shield HP increased and has Fortress Shield.
Fairly difficult to shoot down.

Gains the PD Laser it lost years ago in the .8a fighter rework, attempts to defend itself
against stray SRMs or interceptors. Also has Plasma Jets, letting it rapidly return to the carrier to rearm.

Light Proximity Launcher now deals Fragmentation damage like the standard version. Charges are
launched much faster, and have a large blast radius. Can't easily bash through shields unlike
vanilla version, due to frag payloads, and struggles with armored targets. The PD nature of it's payload
clears a path through defending interceptors and PD missile projectiles, giving it a support role in bomber formations.

Weapon arcs improved, IRPL has 360 coverage. IRPL (High Delay) can now target missiles, providing decent PD.

Gains a Vulcan on each side, stops most missiles. Now exceptionally fast, fires it's rockets in a wide spread from long range.

Speed increased, attack behavior changed, no longer runs ahead of escorting fighters.

Armed with a weaker Graviton Beam in place of the IRPL.
Fills a role similar to the Broadsword, much more survivable against
explosive PD, much less against kinetic & frag.

Now has the High Energy Focus system and Advanced Optics.
Can occasionally shoot down slow moving targets.

Gains Maneuvering Jets, Insulated Engines. Much more survivable, now actually worth 18 OP.

Now armed with a Light MG. Launches bombs more rapidly, but fewer in total.

Gains IPDAI, maneuverability tweaks. Very good PD with DTA.

Vulcan firing arcs improved, Swarmer (fighter) adjusted for PD role alongside
standard Swarmer. Can intercept missiles and fighters fairly well.

Speed reduced, maneuverability increased, given variety of hullmods.
Now has the standard Flares system to decoy missiles.

Now armed with 2 LRPD Lasers and fitted with Advanced Optics. Increased shield durability.
Much better than Daggers at surviving, longer time between strikes due to low speed.
Good multipurpose fighter on ships using DTA.

Weapons replaced with a Thumper and 2 Swarmer (fighter). Speed reduced, given Maneuvering Jets to
compensate in bursts. Engagement range increased to the standard 4000.
Difficult target for a ship with only frag or kinetic PD.

Gains 4000 support range, can now escort allies at a distance. New shipsystem, Active Flares.

Hullmods

Spoiler

No longer has a flat +1DP cost. Mounting a fighter with more than 0 OP cost will
still cost 1DP, but allows Mining Pods to be used with no DP increase.

Cost reduced.

Now provides enhanced benefits to frigates when near larger ships,
though it can't be freely installed. Reduced OP cost for cruisers.

Number of reloads/missile mounts adjusted. Maximum reloads with 1-2-3-4 mounts for
frigates, destroyers, cruisers, and capital ships respectively.

Shipsystems

Spoiler

Flare speed and decoy chance increased, system now launches flares in a long sequence rather than in a burst.
Much less likely all the flares target a single missile, generally much more effective.
Increased cooldown prevents ship AI from fluxing out by spamming it.

Increased the range of the triggered weapon, much better at intercepting fast, durable missiles.

Cooldown increased. While technically a nerf, prevents trigger happy AI
from dumping its entire missile reserve into bad targets.

Fewer flares launched per salvo, but regenerates charges. Pretty good at keeping
ECCM-less Harpoons away from Hounds and Buffalo mk2s.

Now has 2 charges, longer cooldown. Base flux generation reduced. Charges help deliver a decisive
strike-recall-strike-recall-strike at the beginning of combat or after a time spend regrouping.

Frigates

Spoiler

Brawlers receive an increase to speed and flux, as well as free AWM. Fills the same
role as in vanilla as an early game bully, but stays viable for a bit longer.

Brawler (LG) gains OP, Plasma Jets, and a slight shield efficiency boost but looses a
bit of base speed. Weaker statline than Brawler (TT) but able to bring small ballistics.

Gets Missile Autoloader built-in. Benefits from small weapon rebalancing.

Reduced LG OP penalty, slight increase to speed and shields. Energy Bolt Coherer boosting
IRPL to 700 range makes these less of a downgrade compared to stock Centurion.

Built-in Ballistic Rangefinder, in addition to speed and durability increases.
Will enjoy a slight range advantage in fights, and is less of a liability in combat compared to vanilla.

Medium mount is now Composite, default variant uses a Jackhammer.
Much scarier when spammed in Luddic Path fleets.

Burn drive replaced with Plasma Burn, frontal turrets now Hybrid.
Ersatz fast attack frigate when armed with Phase Lance and kinetics.

Stronger hull and weapon arcs increase. Now comes with built-in Efficiency Overhaul
and Escort Package. Flare Launcher now slowly regenerates charges.

Burn drive replaces stock flares, medium mount now Composite.
Fast missile threat in Pather fleets, budget objective grabber in player fleets.

Flares replaced with Maneuvering Jets, all weapons now Hybrid, gets Unstable Injector built-in.
Agility makes it a slippery target, but lack of flares make it vulnerable to missiles.

Increases to armor, speed, and AWM built-in. Can duel most frigates pretty well, and the
speed increase keeps it semi-viable in the endgame. Still unhappy fighting anything bigger.

OP increase, as well as built-in ECCM and Accelerated Shields.
Extra annoying in Remnant fleets, and a viable alternative to the Glimmer for player fleets.

Turret arc increased, can now reliably shoot targets in front with the rightmost turret.

Durability increase, built-in Efficiency Overhaul, all weapons now Composite.
Essentially a disposable automated Kite, can zoom around and torpedo things.

Regains its long lost waist mounts as synergy turrets, along with a general stat increase.
Much more competitive with the Tempest.

Faster and slightly more durable, comes with ECCM and
Efficiency Overhaul built-in, more OP. Missile support on a budget.

Now has Escort Package built-in. Can serve as a pretty effective bodyguard for
larger ships, phase cloak helps it stay out of allies' firing lines.

Built-in ECCM. Terminator drone's missile mode now has much more lifetime,
leading to fewer burnouts when switching targets.

Bulkier, faster, Ballistic Rangefinder Built-in. Very strong earlygame, less of a drop-off lategame.
Improved small & medium anti-armor options keep it sane.

Missile heavy weapon adjustment, built-in Unstable Injector.

Faster, more dissipation, built-in Nav Relay, Escort Package, and ECCM.
Medium turret now has 360 traverse, gains a built-in Swarmer launcher.
The stat boosts from Escort Package make the Vigilance much better, able to support
allies with FMR missile spam and long range HVD plinking.

Tougher, with built-in Escort Package and Efficiency Overhaul.
Cheap fire support option for automated fleets.

Armor increase, DP reduced to 4, built-in AWM, turret arcs improved.
Much more capable in a fight, now justifiable as a combat freighter.

Turret arcs improved, Accelerated Shields built-in. Accel shields make it less likely to eat stray shots while
skimming. Effective use of rebalanced energy weapons.

Destroyers

Spoiler

Built-in ATG and Efficiency Overhaul, durability and speed increase, more flux dissipation.
Turret arcs improved, impressive DPS when loaded with autocannons.

Speed and OP increased, can now support fighters and missiles without S-modding.
Still very sluggish and fragile.

Much tougher, built-in Efficiency Overhaul and AWM. Hardpoint arcs improved, smalls
switched to Composite. Very tough for the low price, scary with SO.

DP reduced to 11, speed increased, Recovery Shuttles built-in. More competitive with other carriers.

Durability, speed, flux dissipation increase, Escort Package and Rugged Construction built-in.
Turret arcs slightly increased, 2 small missiles switched to composite.
Bully in the early game, disposable meatshield cost effective escort in the lategame.

Reworked missile focused armament, Burn Drive replaced with Plasma Burn, built-in
Missile Autoloader and Unstable Injector. Good fast-attack ship, less effective in traditional escort/line roles.

Weapon arcs adjusted to stop it fighting backwards in odd situations.
Blessed with the holy CARRIER hint, no longer charges into combat.

Flux stats improved, OP increase, all small turrets can now converge. Prow small turrets now Universal,
allowing 4x small missiles in exchange for less gunpower. Good user of the reworked ACG.

Speed and shield efficiency increase, OP penalty reduced. Blends High-Tech and midline, decent sidegrade.

Speed increase, central hardpoint now Universal. Quantum Disruptor + Reaper.

Hull and dissipation increase, Resistant Flux Conduits built-in, DP reduced to 11.
Slightly more competitive with the Sunder for the role of fire support destroyer.

Canister Flack replaced with Active Flares, hardpoints switched to hybrid, smalls switched to
composite, DP reduced to 10, Unstable Injector built-in. Good speed combined with versatile
armament give it unique loadout options.

Turret arcs improved, Rugged Construction built-in.

OP increase, had less than cheaper carriers despite the opportunity cost of Automated Ships.

Speed and capacity increase, ECCM built-in. Margin of speed over
stronger destroyers is enough to usually disengage.

High Resolution Sensors built-in.

Speed and shield efficiency slightly increased, OP penalty reduced.
Hardpoints switched to synergy, for even more beams.

Losses Civilian Grade Hull, gains Rugged Construction. More reasons to pick Tarsus over a
Buffalo, particularly if both have many D-mods.

Cruisers

Spoiler

Adequate as an enemy ship, but not good at all in player fleets. DP reduced to 28, DTA built-in.
Reckless AI pilots it surprisingly well, due to long range and lack of speed, semi viable choice for automated points.

Turret arcs improved, medium energies can converge ahead.

Small energy opposite waist medium synergy mount is now synergy, ECCM built-in.

Restored to its pre .96 version, slightly increased speed, built-in ECCM.

Significant OP buff, turret arcs increase, built-in Escort Package and ATG.
Frontal small turrets changed, outside turrets now universal, inside now hybrid.
Easier to justify over running more capitals.

Improved turret arcs, frontal turrets switched to composite. Should be marginally more dangerous.

Turret arcs improved, waist turrets switched to missile, missile Autoloader built-in.
Slightly more dangerous in pirate fleets and a bit more interesting in player fleets.

Increased speed, improved firing arcs, Escort Package and AWM built-in.
Still the slowest combat cruiser, but won't struggle as much to aim its hardpoints.

Speed slightly increased, medium hardpoints now universal, ECCM built-in.

Minor turret arc improvements, Missile Autoloader built-in.

Shield efficiency increase, speed and OP penalty decreased. Plasma Jets replace Maneuvering Jets,
mount types adjusted. Faster than standard Eagle on average, no longer a direct downgrade.

Turret arcs improved, DP reduced to 20, Insulated Engines built-in.

Same treatment as Eagle.

Same as Eagle (LG), small energy turrets now hybrid.

Flux capacity and OP improved, turret arcs improved, waist small
energy mounts now synergy, ECCM built-in. DP returned to 18.

Better flux stats, regains built-in EMR. Not quite as weak if forced into a gunfight, though still not good at it.

Flux stats, OP, and PPT improved. Frontal small turrets now universal. Battle Heron is only mostly a meme now.

Flux stats, speed, OP, improved. Missile turrets are now composite, ballistic hardpoint now missile.
Has enough OP to invest into fighters and protection, and enough dissipation to support more than a few LACs.

OP increase, Efficiency Overhaul and Dedicated Targeting Core built-in.

Capitals

Spoiler

Astral has been changed significantly, with better stats, mount types, and weapon arcs.
Now a competent battlecarrier, the Astral isn't totally useless when faced with decent PD
and justifies its 50 DP cost. May be slightly overpowered.

Mobility and OP increase, BRF and ATG built-in. Frontal turrets arcs improved, broadside
given subtle asymmetry to assist AI piloting. 2 Small turrets per side now Hybrid.
Less likely to randomly explode.

OP increased, turret arcs slightly increased. More competitive with Paragon.

Small turret arcs improved, all can converge frontally.

Large missiles switched to composite, central medium turret now universal

Shield now Omni, 60 degree arc. Should make charging Novas less of a free kill.

Arcs of small turrets improved, medium missile turrets now synergy.

Arc of small turrets improved. Wing large turrets have slightly improved coverage to the side.

Arcs of turrets improved, 2 small wing turrets now synergy.

Speed returned to 50, corner energy turrets now missile, EMR, High Resolution Sensors,
Missile Autoloader, built-in, Turret arcs improved. Hybrid turrets now Universal.
The speed and effective OP increase make this ship much more reliable, particularly
with improved ai hints on its main weapons.

BRF and AWM built-in. A bit more cannon with the glass.

Stations

Spoiler

Lowtech stations are much stronger, with improved weapon arcs, flux stats, and actual shipsystems.
Merlon drones are now considered fighters and won't block the station's firing lines.
Approximately as strong as the other station types.

Enhanced alongside the lowtech station. Main broadside module has increased flux stats (1250->2750 dissipation)
and Accelerated Ammo Feed, much scarier. Ravelin drones are now considered fighters
and won't block firing lines. Fights very well if given a supporting fleet.

Mostly unchanged, barring the same adjustments to its support drones.
No longer the obvious choice for player colonies, though still arguably the strongest.

Improved weapon arcs and all modules have relevant systems. Substantially more dangerous.

Redacted

Spoiler

OP cost reduced, high cost didn't seem justified by performance.

Reduced maneuverability (30->20 degrees/second).
Will have some trouble keeping it's hardpoints aimed at frigates during Incursion Mode.

Projectile speed increased (500->600). Less inconsistent aiming when firing
ship and target have significant speed difference.

Spread adjusted and flux cost reduced. Should be somewhat better at hitting smaller ships,
still able to melt armor across a wide area.

Given a short ramp-up period, makes it slightly harder for Line Units to escape.

OP cost reduced.

System now has a ramp-up period, instead of instantly reaching full power.
Friendly ships better able to react to the danger and are blindsided less often.
Added cooldown prevents the same Assault Unit from being immediately
re-buffed after system ends.

OP cost reduced, range and efficiency increased. Pretty effective PD, but still very expensive.

Range and top speed increased, HP damage and maneuverability decreased.
Less effective when spammed and can be dodged by small ships.

Efficiency increased, now competitive with the Light Needler.

OP cost reduced, projectile speed increased (400->600).
Much better when firing at or used by fast ships.

OP cost reduced. Enough disadvantages compared to the Railgun
and Light Needler that the increased cost was too punitive.

Ammo and acceleration increased, now a 2-stage missile like the squall. Easily avoided
by mobile ships.

The Disruptor's projectile has now has collision can be shot down, allowing
a little counterplay. Still incredibly strong, but less effective against massed PD.

Can now fire over allies and has increased range.
Excellent PD and decent against small ships.

OP cost reduced, efficiency matches Phase Lance.

OP cost reduced.

OP cost reduced, range increased. Effective on ships with EBC or Elite PD (or both).

Speed and maneuverability reduced. Small or fast ships will have an easier time staying out of its killzone.

Damage reduced, no longer oneshots Missile Spec boosted Reapers.
Given longer reload to decrease its uptime.
Threat ship & swarms will spend fragments on other weapons.

Now has the same shield avoidance as the Mining Blaster.
Damage reduced to compensate.
More predictable under AI control, peak performance reduced.
Projectiles given a faint tracer to improve visual clarity.

Projectile velocity increased (300->400).
Can much more reliably hit moving ships, much better overall.

OP cost decreased. Effective cost is still high, considering the cost of Fragment Swarm.

Screenshots

reliable, with an interruptible charge-up and much faster turning speed, which somewhat makes up for the loss in DPS.



Like the Gauss, Mjolnir use is mostly limited to the Conquest. Flux efficiency is increased
slightly, along with significant increases to the EMP damage and projectile speed (900->1100).



The Light Needler is slightly too strong, and is now exactly half a Heavy Needler in terms of dps.
Nerfed refire delay now exactly matches both the Heavy Mauler and Phase Lance, which
makes Phase anchor builds combining these weapons slightly better under AI control.

Energy Weapons
Spoiler

The Anti-matter Blaster overperforms on ships that can ignore the 1500 soft flux load, and is a
major contributor to the success of the Afflictor. Reducing it's OP cost and damage while increasing
efficiency and range makes it an option on more ships while weakening its main abusers.



Now gains charges in sets of 15, rather than continuously. Noticeably better on ships with
HEF, minimal difference elsewhere.



A mediocre weapon, the IRPL limits ships that rely on small energies for shield pressure.
Range, efficiency, and OP cost have been improved.
Projectile velocity doubled, making it very accurate against fast moving targets.



Less mediocre than the IRPL, but still a bit lacking.
Range increased, now a genuinely medium-range weapon.
Viable choice on aggressive midline builds, great with EBC.



The Heavy Blaster is mostly restricted to SO ships due to the massive flux generation.
An efficiency improvement and a minor EMP component mitigate this somewhat.



The Kinetic Blaster often finds its place filled by the Pulse Laser or Heavy Blaster.
To set it apart, it now fires a more efficient 4-shot burst. On ships with HEF this can threaten smaller
ships with immediate overloads



The Ion Cannon's relatively low EMP output and low range make it the most
affected by enemy EMP reduction. A buff to the EMP damage and flux efficiency
balances the risk vs reward.



Ranged and DPS increased, damage type switched to HE to match the Mining Blaster.
Allows ships relying on Frag or Kinetic PD to handle armored fighters.



The PD Laser has been adjusted to be a dual purpose weapon, offering
average PD effectiveness alongside light-armor melting.



The Vanilla LRPD Laser's low DPS makes in unsuited for stopping much more than stray salamanders.
An increase in range and the ability to fire over allied ships makes massed LRPDs much more effective.
A smidge of EMP makes many converging beams able to disable fighters somewhat reliably.




The Burst PD Lasers have been slightly adjusted, firing shorter more intense bursts.
This slightly improves effectiveness against armor and reduces overkill when engaging multiple targets.



The Paladin has been given a general statistical buff, but regains charges in blocks of 10 rather
than continuously. This presents windows of vulnerability if a ship has no other PD.



An OP decrease, efficiency increase, and minor EMP addition make the
Tactical Laser easier to mass and somewhat more effective.



The Phase Lance now fires without the chargup-chargedown period, dealing the entire
burst's damage at the full hitstrength. Slight stat reduction to compensate.

Missiles
Spoiler


Both launchers gain more ammo, rockets are faster and slightly more durability.
Pod now releases rockets at max speed, much better at leading moving targets.




Years ago, in .8a the Atropos had it's speed nerfed from 500-400 but didn't gain any lifetime to compensate.
This, combined with it's lazy guidance leads to frequent burnouts and misses just before impact if fired near max range.
Range and speed increased, now closer in performance to unguided torpedoes.




AI hints adjusted to make ships more willing to fire in less perfect situations.
Practical effectiveness increased somewhat.



Implemented an unused vanilla weapon, essentially an HE bomblet shotgun.
Only effective at point blank or against stationary targets.





Increased HP, all launchers now release the torpedo at maximum speed.
Larger launchers have slightly more ammo.




Faster fire and reloading rate. Secondary stage has increased HP and
speed, still just as clumsy. Very effective at baiting missile PD.




Ammo increased, cooldown of small slight increased.




More ammo, higher missile HP and lifetime.



Reworked, the Swarmer is now regenerates ammo and prefers missiles
and fighters to ships. Missiles have a proximity warhead. Changes apply to the fighter version.



Reworked into a PD/Assault weapon, the PCL now provides
exceptional PD, limited by very long ammo reloads.



Reworked into a regenerating PD/Suppression weapon, the Locust fires single missiles and provides area PD
similarly to a Paladin. Lacks the splash damage of the other missile slot PD options.




Reworked into a regenerating MRM to give it a role not already filled by the Sabot. Essentially a 2500 range
Graviton Beam with 75% of the DPS, dropping to 50% once reserves empty.
Missiles are quite tough, and draw PD attention away from more valuable missiles.




Increased ammo alongside changes to other missiles.




Much more ammo for both medium and large Dragonfires. More lifetime, durability, greater
standoff range, and improved AI hints make it much more reliable.



Reworked; now regenerates ammo and builds flux to fire. Base damage decreased but
bonus damage increased. Now flies very fast and deals significant EMP damage.



Increased ammo and adjusted AI hints. Should fire at vulnerable targets more often.

Fighters
SpoilerAll fighters have had their speed and maneuverability stats adjusted. A blanket deceleration nerf keeps fighters
from slowing down, and makes them more difficult targets for PD. Bombers have their attack range
increased, and are agile enough to turn away before entering most PD range.



LMG weapon arcs increased significantly, spends much more time shooting and less time turning to shoot.



Durability and speed slightly improved. Ion Cannon (High Delay) now fires a burst of 2 shots, DPS unchanged.
The burst firing focuses EMP on fewer parts of the target, and more reliably disables components.



Now has ECCM and launches its Reaper from much longer range. Shield HP increased and has Fortress Shield.
Fairly difficult to shoot down.



Gains the PD Laser it lost years ago in the .8a fighter rework, attempts to defend itself
against stray SRMs or interceptors. Also has Plasma Jets, letting it rapidly return to the carrier to rearm.



Light Proximity Launcher now deals Fragmentation damage like the standard version. Charges are
launched much faster, and have a large blast radius. Can't easily bash through shields unlike
vanilla version, due to frag payloads, and struggles with armored targets. The PD nature of it's payload
clears a path through defending interceptors and PD missile projectiles, giving it a support role in bomber formations.



Weapon arcs improved, IRPL has 360 coverage. IRPL (High Delay) can now target missiles, providing decent PD.



Gains a Vulcan on each side, stops most missiles. Now exceptionally fast, fires it's rockets in a wide spread from long range.



Speed increased, attack behavior changed, no longer runs ahead of escorting fighters.



Armed with a weaker Graviton Beam in place of the IRPL.
Fills a role similar to the Broadsword, much more survivable against
explosive PD, much less against kinetic & frag.



Now has the High Energy Focus system and Advanced Optics.
Can occasionally shoot down slow moving targets.



Gains Maneuvering Jets, Insulated Engines. Much more survivable, now actually worth 18 OP.



Now armed with a Light MG. Launches bombs more rapidly, but fewer in total.



Gains IPDAI, maneuverability tweaks. Very good PD with DTA.



Vulcan firing arcs improved, Swarmer (fighter) adjusted for PD role alongside
standard Swarmer. Can intercept missiles and fighters fairly well.



Speed reduced, maneuverability increased, given variety of hullmods.
Now has the standard Flares system to decoy missiles.



Now armed with 2 LRPD Lasers and fitted with Advanced Optics. Increased shield durability.
Much better than Daggers at surviving, longer time between strikes due to low speed.
Good multipurpose fighter on ships using DTA.



Weapons replaced with a Thumper and 2 Swarmer (fighter). Speed reduced, given Maneuvering Jets to
compensate in bursts. Engagement range increased to the standard 4000.
Difficult target for a ship with only frag or kinetic PD.



Gains 4000 support range, can now escort allies at a distance. New shipsystem, Active Flares.

Hullmods
Spoiler

No longer has a flat +1DP cost. Mounting a fighter with more than 0 OP cost will
still cost 1DP, but allows Mining Pods to be used with no DP increase.



Cost reduced.



Now provides enhanced benefits to frigates when near larger ships,
though it can't be freely installed. Reduced OP cost for cruisers.



Number of reloads/missile mounts adjusted. Maximum reloads with 1-2-3-4 mounts for
frigates, destroyers, cruisers, and capital ships respectively.

Shipsystems
Spoiler

Flare speed and decoy chance increased, system now launches flares in a long sequence rather than in a burst.
Much less likely all the flares target a single missile, generally much more effective.
Increased cooldown prevents ship AI from fluxing out by spamming it.



Increased the range of the triggered weapon, much better at intercepting fast, durable missiles.



Cooldown increased. While technically a nerf, prevents trigger happy AI
from dumping its entire missile reserve into bad targets.



Fewer flares launched per salvo, but regenerates charges. Pretty good at keeping
ECCM-less Harpoons away from Hounds and Buffalo mk2s.



Now has 2 charges, longer cooldown. Base flux generation reduced. Charges help deliver a decisive
strike-recall-strike-recall-strike at the beginning of combat or after a time spend regrouping.


Frigates
Spoiler

Brawlers receive an increase to speed and flux, as well as free AWM. Fills the same
role as in vanilla as an early game bully, but stays viable for a bit longer.



Brawler (LG) gains OP, Plasma Jets, and a slight shield efficiency boost but looses a
bit of base speed. Weaker statline than Brawler (TT) but able to bring small ballistics.



Gets Missile Autoloader built-in. Benefits from small weapon rebalancing.



Reduced LG OP penalty, slight increase to speed and shields. Energy Bolt Coherer boosting
IRPL to 700 range makes these less of a downgrade compared to stock Centurion.



Built-in Ballistic Rangefinder, in addition to speed and durability increases.
Will enjoy a slight range advantage in fights, and is less of a liability in combat compared to vanilla.



Medium mount is now Composite, default variant uses a Jackhammer.
Much scarier when spammed in Luddic Path fleets.



Burn drive replaced with Plasma Burn, frontal turrets now Hybrid.
Ersatz fast attack frigate when armed with Phase Lance and kinetics.



Stronger hull and weapon arcs increase. Now comes with built-in Efficiency Overhaul
and Escort Package. Flare Launcher now slowly regenerates charges.



Burn drive replaces stock flares, medium mount now Composite.
Fast missile threat in Pather fleets, budget objective grabber in player fleets.



Flares replaced with Maneuvering Jets, all weapons now Hybrid, gets Unstable Injector built-in.
Agility makes it a slippery target, but lack of flares make it vulnerable to missiles.



Increases to armor, speed, and AWM built-in. Can duel most frigates pretty well, and the
speed increase keeps it semi-viable in the endgame. Still unhappy fighting anything bigger.



OP increase, as well as built-in ECCM and Accelerated Shields.
Extra annoying in Remnant fleets, and a viable alternative to the Glimmer for player fleets.



Turret arc increased, can now reliably shoot targets in front with the rightmost turret.



Durability increase, built-in Efficiency Overhaul, all weapons now Composite.
Essentially a disposable automated Kite, can zoom around and torpedo things.



Regains its long lost waist mounts as synergy turrets, along with a general stat increase.
Much more competitive with the Tempest.



Faster and slightly more durable, comes with ECCM and
Efficiency Overhaul built-in, more OP. Missile support on a budget.



Now has Escort Package built-in. Can serve as a pretty effective bodyguard for
larger ships, phase cloak helps it stay out of allies' firing lines.



Built-in ECCM. Terminator drone's missile mode now has much more lifetime,
leading to fewer burnouts when switching targets.



Bulkier, faster, Ballistic Rangefinder Built-in. Very strong earlygame, less of a drop-off lategame.
Improved small & medium anti-armor options keep it sane.



Missile heavy weapon adjustment, built-in Unstable Injector.



Faster, more dissipation, built-in Nav Relay, Escort Package, and ECCM.
Medium turret now has 360 traverse, gains a built-in Swarmer launcher.
The stat boosts from Escort Package make the Vigilance much better, able to support
allies with FMR missile spam and long range HVD plinking.



Tougher, with built-in Escort Package and Efficiency Overhaul.
Cheap fire support option for automated fleets.



Armor increase, DP reduced to 4, built-in AWM, turret arcs improved.
Much more capable in a fight, now justifiable as a combat freighter.



Turret arcs improved, Accelerated Shields built-in. Accel shields make it less likely to eat stray shots while
skimming. Effective use of rebalanced energy weapons.

Destroyers
Spoiler

Built-in ATG and Efficiency Overhaul, durability and speed increase, more flux dissipation.
Turret arcs improved, impressive DPS when loaded with autocannons.



Speed and OP increased, can now support fighters and missiles without S-modding.
Still very sluggish and fragile.



Much tougher, built-in Efficiency Overhaul and AWM. Hardpoint arcs improved, smalls
switched to Composite. Very tough for the low price, scary with SO.



DP reduced to 11, speed increased, Recovery Shuttles built-in. More competitive with other carriers.



Durability, speed, flux dissipation increase, Escort Package and Rugged Construction built-in.
Turret arcs slightly increased, 2 small missiles switched to composite.
Bully in the early game, disposable meatshield cost effective escort in the lategame.



Reworked missile focused armament, Burn Drive replaced with Plasma Burn, built-in
Missile Autoloader and Unstable Injector. Good fast-attack ship, less effective in traditional escort/line roles.



Weapon arcs adjusted to stop it fighting backwards in odd situations.
Blessed with the holy CARRIER hint, no longer charges into combat.



Flux stats improved, OP increase, all small turrets can now converge. Prow small turrets now Universal,
allowing 4x small missiles in exchange for less gunpower. Good user of the reworked ACG.



Speed and shield efficiency increase, OP penalty reduced. Blends High-Tech and midline, decent sidegrade.



Speed increase, central hardpoint now Universal. Quantum Disruptor + Reaper.



Hull and dissipation increase, Resistant Flux Conduits built-in, DP reduced to 11.
Slightly more competitive with the Sunder for the role of fire support destroyer.



Canister Flack replaced with Active Flares, hardpoints switched to hybrid, smalls switched to
composite, DP reduced to 10, Unstable Injector built-in. Good speed combined with versatile
armament give it unique loadout options.



Turret arcs improved, Rugged Construction built-in.



OP increase, had less than cheaper carriers despite the opportunity cost of Automated Ships.



Speed and capacity increase, ECCM built-in. Margin of speed over
stronger destroyers is enough to usually disengage.



High Resolution Sensors built-in.



Speed and shield efficiency slightly increased, OP penalty reduced.
Hardpoints switched to synergy, for even more beams.



Losses Civilian Grade Hull, gains Rugged Construction. More reasons to pick Tarsus over a
Buffalo, particularly if both have many D-mods.

Cruisers
Spoiler

Adequate as an enemy ship, but not good at all in player fleets. DP reduced to 28, DTA built-in.
Reckless AI pilots it surprisingly well, due to long range and lack of speed, semi viable choice for automated points.



Turret arcs improved, medium energies can converge ahead.



Small energy opposite waist medium synergy mount is now synergy, ECCM built-in.



Restored to its pre .96 version, slightly increased speed, built-in ECCM.



Significant OP buff, turret arcs increase, built-in Escort Package and ATG.
Frontal small turrets changed, outside turrets now universal, inside now hybrid.
Easier to justify over running more capitals.



Improved turret arcs, frontal turrets switched to composite. Should be marginally more dangerous.



Turret arcs improved, waist turrets switched to missile, missile Autoloader built-in.
Slightly more dangerous in pirate fleets and a bit more interesting in player fleets.



Increased speed, improved firing arcs, Escort Package and AWM built-in.
Still the slowest combat cruiser, but won't struggle as much to aim its hardpoints.



Speed slightly increased, medium hardpoints now universal, ECCM built-in.



Minor turret arc improvements, Missile Autoloader built-in.



Shield efficiency increase, speed and OP penalty decreased. Plasma Jets replace Maneuvering Jets,
mount types adjusted. Faster than standard Eagle on average, no longer a direct downgrade.



Turret arcs improved, DP reduced to 20, Insulated Engines built-in.



Same treatment as Eagle.



Same as Eagle (LG), small energy turrets now hybrid.



Flux capacity and OP improved, turret arcs improved, waist small
energy mounts now synergy, ECCM built-in. DP returned to 18.



Better flux stats, regains built-in EMR. Not quite as weak if forced into a gunfight, though still not good at it.



Flux stats, OP, and PPT improved. Frontal small turrets now universal. Battle Heron is only mostly a meme now.



Flux stats, speed, OP, improved. Missile turrets are now composite, ballistic hardpoint now missile.
Has enough OP to invest into fighters and protection, and enough dissipation to support more than a few LACs.



OP increase, Efficiency Overhaul and Dedicated Targeting Core built-in.

Capitals
Spoiler

Astral has been changed significantly, with better stats, mount types, and weapon arcs.
Now a competent battlecarrier, the Astral isn't totally useless when faced with decent PD
and justifies its 50 DP cost. May be slightly overpowered.



Mobility and OP increase, BRF and ATG built-in. Frontal turrets arcs improved, broadside
given subtle asymmetry to assist AI piloting. 2 Small turrets per side now Hybrid.
Less likely to randomly explode.



OP increased, turret arcs slightly increased. More competitive with Paragon.



Small turret arcs improved, all can converge frontally.



Large missiles switched to composite, central medium turret now universal



Shield now Omni, 60 degree arc. Should make charging Novas less of a free kill.



Arcs of small turrets improved, medium missile turrets now synergy.



Arc of small turrets improved. Wing large turrets have slightly improved coverage to the side.



Arcs of turrets improved, 2 small wing turrets now synergy.



Speed returned to 50, corner energy turrets now missile, EMR, High Resolution Sensors,
Missile Autoloader, built-in, Turret arcs improved. Hybrid turrets now Universal.
The speed and effective OP increase make this ship much more reliable, particularly
with improved ai hints on its main weapons.



BRF and AWM built-in. A bit more cannon with the glass.

Stations
Spoiler

Lowtech stations are much stronger, with improved weapon arcs, flux stats, and actual shipsystems.
Merlon drones are now considered fighters and won't block the station's firing lines.
Approximately as strong as the other station types.



Enhanced alongside the lowtech station. Main broadside module has increased flux stats (1250->2750 dissipation)
and Accelerated Ammo Feed, much scarier. Ravelin drones are now considered fighters
and won't block firing lines. Fights very well if given a supporting fleet.



Mostly unchanged, barring the same adjustments to its support drones.
No longer the obvious choice for player colonies, though still arguably the strongest.



Improved weapon arcs and all modules have relevant systems. Substantially more dangerous.


Redacted
Spoiler

OP cost reduced, high cost didn't seem justified by performance.



Reduced maneuverability (30->20 degrees/second).
Will have some trouble keeping it's hardpoints aimed at frigates during Incursion Mode.



Projectile speed increased (500->600). Less inconsistent aiming when firing
ship and target have significant speed difference.



Spread adjusted and flux cost reduced. Should be somewhat better at hitting smaller ships,
still able to melt armor across a wide area.



Given a short ramp-up period, makes it slightly harder for Line Units to escape.



OP cost reduced.



System now has a ramp-up period, instead of instantly reaching full power.
Friendly ships better able to react to the danger and are blindsided less often.
Added cooldown prevents the same Assault Unit from being immediately
re-buffed after system ends.



OP cost reduced, range and efficiency increased. Pretty effective PD, but still very expensive.



Range and top speed increased, HP damage and maneuverability decreased.
Less effective when spammed and can be dodged by small ships.



Efficiency increased, now competitive with the Light Needler.



OP cost reduced, projectile speed increased (400->600).
Much better when firing at or used by fast ships.



OP cost reduced. Enough disadvantages compared to the Railgun
and Light Needler that the increased cost was too punitive.



Ammo and acceleration increased, now a 2-stage missile like the squall. Easily avoided
by mobile ships.



The Disruptor's projectile has now has collision can be shot down, allowing
a little counterplay. Still incredibly strong, but less effective against massed PD.



Can now fire over allies and has increased range.
Excellent PD and decent against small ships.



OP cost reduced, efficiency matches Phase Lance.



OP cost reduced.



OP cost reduced, range increased. Effective on ships with EBC or Elite PD (or both).



Speed and maneuverability reduced. Small or fast ships will have an easier time staying out of its killzone.



Damage reduced, no longer oneshots Missile Spec boosted Reapers.
Given longer reload to decrease its uptime.
Threat ship & swarms will spend fragments on other weapons.



Now has the same shield avoidance as the Mining Blaster.
Damage reduced to compensate.
More predictable under AI control, peak performance reduced.
Projectiles given a faint tracer to improve visual clarity.



Projectile velocity increased (300->400).
Can much more reliably hit moving ships, much better overall.



OP cost decreased. Effective cost is still high, considering the cost of Fragment Swarm.

Spoiler
aiDescription: Rebalances a wide variety of vanilla content including ballistics, energy weapons, missiles, and fighters. It modifies ship variants to account for the new weapon and stat values, aiming to increase tactical variety and fix weak choices.
saveCompatibilityText: Should be safe to add/remove from existing saves, though ships should be stripped of equipment before removal
removalCompatibilityText: Should be safe to add/remove from existing saves, though ships should be stripped of equipment before removal
